verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS operations-automation platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no public API reference or runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. The vendor pages describe only in-app workflows and integrations with Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
